scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace client" "npm run dev --workspace server"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n auth,client,server -c yellow,cyan,green "firebase emulators:start --only auth --project demo-taskflow" "npm run dev --workspace client" "npm run dev --workspace server"

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace client && npm run test --workspace server
